origin: Generated educational size-scaled kernel, not an unmodified external benchmark or a new model sampling experiment

verification.algorithm: certified relational summaries with residual-C abstraction/refinement
verification.engine_selection: No router: ESBMC checks the residual C product; custom SMT proofs justify region abstraction.

contract.observations: Return value and every final parameter-array element
contract.memory: All parameter arrays valid and pairwise nonoverlapping; initial contents shared by value
contract.safety: Both programs must be free of modelled undefined behavior on the entire stated input domain
contract.proof_scope: Functional C equivalence at completion, not cycle-level or C-to-RTL equivalence

region_analysis.boundary: All parameter arrays; unchanged scalar parameters; no local live-outs

verification.counterexample_validation: Actual unabstracted C miter refuted at the custom SMT witness

smt_replay.scope: Matching current/archived implementation and saved artifact hashes; accepted SMT lemmas replayed with Z3. ESBMC log retained, not an independent proof certificate.

native_witness.scope: Actual original C and candidate C at the complete verified input; no abstract state is executed
